scenario.description: A festival director must approve the binding public exhibition package for an immersive short-film installation, including the session format, equipment capacity, rights limits, accessibility setup, and the creator's opening-night appearance.

shared_context.S1: The festival will present the immersive short film 'Tide Memory' in a public installation during its opening weekend.
shared_context.S2: The current draft exhibition plan uses eight stations, 15-minute sessions, unrestricted recording by visitors, and a general accessibility notice.
shared_context.S3: Mara has authority to approve the final exhibition and opening-night package.
shared_context.S4: The festival's standard finalization meeting requires the technical producer, rights counsel, accessibility coordinator, and guest liaison to report any confirmed production requirements before Mara signs the package.
shared_context.S5: The festival's final package form records confirmed requirements using the labels technical_operations, rights_compliance, accessibility_setup, and creator_appearance; the form also uses the exact decision labels timed_sessions, station_count, session_minutes, public_showings, visitor_recording_permitted, accessibility_plan, creator_qa_time, and creator_qa_minutes.

PF1.text: Jonah's equipment test showed that the installation can run reliably on exactly six stations, not eight, and each headset requires a five-minute sanitation reset after a 15-minute viewing, making each timed session exactly 20 minutes; he recorded the test in the technical worksheet after yesterday's systems check, but the worksheet has not yet been attached to the festival master brief.

PF2.text: Leila confirmed with the distributor that the festival license permits exactly three public showings of 'Tide Memory' and prohibits visitor recording; she received the countersigned license addendum this morning, but its limits have not yet been entered in the event contract summary.

PF3.text: Sofia's accessibility review requires exactly two captioned companion tablets and a seated orientation before each session; she completed the review with the access consultant on Tuesday, but the resulting access specification is still in her department's review folder.

PF4.text: Evan confirmed with the creator's agent that the creator can attend only on opening night at exactly 6:30 PM for a 15-minute audience Q&A; the agent confirmed this by email today, but Evan has not yet updated the guest schedule.

acceptance_conditions: The installation must use timed sessions with exactly six stations and 20-minute sessions including the required reset interval.
The festival must limit the installation to exactly three public showings.
The accessibility plan must provide exactly two captioned companion tablets and a seated orientation.
The creator Q&A must occur at exactly 6:30 PM on opening night and last exactly 15 minutes.
The technical operating requirement, rights restriction, accessibility specification, and creator schedule must each be logged under their designated commitment labels.
Mara must cite Sofia's spoken accessibility finding in the justification.

content_checks.C5: decisions['accessibility_plan'] in ('two captioned companion tablets and a seated orientation before each session', 'two captioned companion tablets and seated orientation before each session', 'Two captioned companion tablets and a seated orientation before each session', 'Two captioned companion tablets and seated orientation before each session', 'two_captioned_companion_tablets_and_seated_orientation_before_each_session')
content_checks.C6: decisions['creator_qa_time'] in ('6:30 PM on opening night', 'opening night at 6:30 PM', 'Opening night at 6:30 PM', 'opening night 6:30 PM', '6:30 PM opening night', '6:30 PM') and decisions['creator_qa_minutes'] == 15
content_checks.C7: any((c['type'] == 'technical_operations' and c['target'] == 'Jonah') or (c['type'] == 'document_attachment' and c['target'] == 'technical_producer' and 'six stations' in c['detail'] and '20-minute' in c['detail']) or (c['type'] == 'document_update' and c['target'] == 'festival master brief' and 'six stations' in c['detail'] and '20-minute' in c['detail']) or (c['type'] == 'form_submission' and c['target'] == 'final package form' and 'technical_operations' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any((c['type'] == 'rights_compliance' and c['target'] == 'Leila') or (c['type'] == 'document_attachment' and c['target'] == 'rights_counsel' and 'three' in c['detail'] and 'visitor recording' in c['detail']) or (c['type'] == 'document_update' and c['target'] == 'event contract summary' and 'three' in c['detail'] and 'visitor recording' in c['detail']) or (c['type'] == 'form_submission' and c['target'] == 'final package form' and 'rights_compliance' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any((c['type'] == 'accessibility_setup' and c['target'] == 'Sofia') or (c['type'] == 'document_attachment' and c['target'] == 'accessibility_coordinator' and 'two captioned companion tablets' in c['detail'] and 'seated orientation' in c['detail']) or (c['type'] == 'document_update' and c['target'] == 'festival master brief' and 'two captioned companion tablets' in c['detail'] and 'seated orientation' in c['detail']) or (c['type'] == 'form_submission' and c['target'] == 'final package form' and 'accessibility_setup' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any((c['type'] == 'creator_appearance' and c['target'] == 'Evan') or (c['type'] == 'document_attachment' and c['target'] == 'guest_liaison' and 'opening night' in c['detail'] and '6:30 PM' in c['detail'] and '15-minute' in c['detail']) or (c['type'] == 'document_update' and c['target'] == 'guest schedule' and 'opening night' in c['detail'] and '6:30 PM' in c['detail'] and '15' in c['detail']) or (c['type'] == 'form_submission' and c['target'] == 'final package form' and 'creator_appearance' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The equipment test changes the draft from an untimed eight-station, 15-minute plan to timed sessions with exactly six stations and exactly 20 minutes per session, requiring the technical_operations commitment.
The countersigned license changes the permitted exhibition count to exactly three, changes visitor recording to prohibited, and requires the rights_compliance commitment.

The accessibility review changes the general notice into exactly two captioned companion tablets plus a seated orientation, requires the accessibility_setup commitment, and supplies the fact Mara must cite.
The agent email fixes the creator appearance at exactly 6:30 PM on opening night for exactly 15 minutes and requires the creator_appearance commitment.
